Caret/M-decode.src_description:
Decodes caret or M-encoded strings, i.e. ^M turns into a newline, M-^] turns into 0x9d. Sources such as `cat -v`.

Please be aware that when using `cat -v` ^_ (caret-underscore) will not be encoded, but represents a valid encoding (namely that of 0x1f).
Caret/M-decode.description:
解码脱字符（caret）或 M- 编码的字符串，即 ^M 变为换行符，M-^] 变为 0x9d。来源例如 `cat -v` 的输出。

请注意，使用 `cat -v` 时 ^_（脱字符加下划线）不会被编码，但它表示一个有效的编码（即 0x1f）。

CBOR Decode.src_description: Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) is a binary data serialization format loosely based on JSON. Like JSON it allows the transmission of data objects that contain name–value pairs, but in a more concise manner. This increases processing and transfer speeds at the cost of human readability. It is defined in IETF RFC 8949.

Converts smart (typographic) Unicode characters — e.g. smart quotes, em/en dashes, ellipses, ©, ®, ™, arrows — into their plain ASCII equivalents.

e.g. “Hello” — world… becomes "Hello" -- world...

没有 ASCII 对应字符的字符（例如 ☣）按“无法映射的字符”选项处理。

例如 “Hello” — world… 变为 "Hello" -- world...

From Base58.src_description:
Base58 (similar to Base64) is a notation for encoding arbitrary byte data. It differs from Base64 by removing easily misread characters (i.e. l, I, 0 and O) to improve human readability.

This operation decodes data from an ASCII string (with an alphabet of your choosing, presets included) back into its raw form.

e.g. StV1DL6CwTryKyV becomes hello world

Base58 is commonly used in cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ripple, etc).
From Base58.description:
Base58（与 Base64 类似）是一种表示任意字节数据的记法。与 Base64 不同的是，它去掉了容易看错的字符（即 l、I、0 和 O），以提高可读性。

此操作将 ASCII 字符串（可选择字母表，内置预设）还原为原始数据。

例如 StV1DL6CwTryKyV 变为 hello world

Base58 常用于加密货币（比特币、瑞波币等）。

From Bech32.src_description:
Bech32 is an encoding scheme primarily used for Bitcoin SegWit addresses (BIP-0173). It uses a 32-character alphabet that excludes easily confused characters (1, b, i, o) and includes a checksum for error detection.

Bech32m (BIP-0350) is an updated version used for Bitcoin Taproot addresses.

Auto-detect will attempt Bech32 first, then Bech32m if the checksum fails.

Output format options allow you to see the Human-Readable Part (HRP) along with the decoded data.
From Bech32.description:

Bech32m（BIP-0350）是用于比特币 Taproot 地址的改进版本。

自动检测会先尝试 Bech32，校验和失败时再尝试 Bech32m。

通过输出格式选项，可以同时查看人类可读部分（HRP）和解码后的数据。

Text-Integer Conversion.src_description:
Converts between text strings and large integers (decimal or hexadecimal).

Text is interpreted as a big-endian sequence of character codes. For example:
ABC is 0x414243 (hex) is 4276803 (decimal)
Input format detection:
Decimal: digits 0-9 only
Hexadecimal: 0x... prefix
Quoted or unquoted text: treated as string

Character limitations:
Text input may only contain ASCII and Latin-1 characters (code point < 256).
Multi-byte Unicode characters will generate an error.

.

十进制：仅包含数字 0-9
十六进制：以 0x 开头
带引号或不带引号的文本：视为字符串

字符限制：
文本输入只能包含 ASCII 和 Latin-1 字符（码点 < 256）。

To Base32.src_description: Base32 is a notation for encoding arbitrary byte data using a restricted set of symbols that can be conveniently used by humans and processed by computers. It uses a smaller set of characters than Base64, usually the uppercase alphabet and the numbers 2 to 7.

To Base58.src_description:
Base58 (similar to Base64) is a notation for encoding arbitrary byte data. It differs from Base64 by removing easily misread characters (i.e. l, I, 0 and O) to improve human readability.

This operation encodes data in an ASCII string (with an alphabet of your choosing, presets included).

e.g. hello world becomes StV1DL6CwTryKyV

Base58 is commonly used in cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ripple, etc).

Base58（与 Base64 类似）是一种表示任意字节数据的记法。与 Base64 不同的是，它去掉了容易看错的字符（即 l、I、0 和 O），以提高可读性。

此操作将数据编码为 ASCII 字符串（可选择字母表，内置预设）。

例如 hello world 变为 StV1DL6CwTryKyV

Base58 常用于加密货币（比特币、瑞波币等）。

To Base85.src_description:
Base85 (also called Ascii85) is a notation for encoding arbitrary byte data. It is usually more efficient that Base64.

This operation encodes data in an ASCII string (with an alphabet of your choosing, presets included).

e.g. hello world becomes BOu!rD]j7BEbo7

Base85 is commonly used in Adobe's PostScript and PDF file formats.

Options
Alphabet
  • Standard - The standard alphabet, referred to as Ascii85
  • Z85 (ZeroMQ) - A string-safe variant of Base85, which avoids quote marks and backslash characters
  • IPv6 - A variant of Base85 suitable for encoding IPv6 addresses (RFC 1924)
Include delimiter
Adds a '<~' and '~>' delimiter to the start and end of the data. This is standard for Adobe's implementation of Base85.
To Base85.description:
Base85（也称 Ascii85）是一种表示任意字节数据的记法，通常比 Base64 更高效。

此操作将数据编码为 ASCII 字符串（可选择字母表，内置预设）。

例如 hello world 变为 BOu!rD]j7BEbo7

Base85 常用于 Adobe 的 PostScript 和 PDF 文件格式。

选项
字母表
  • Standard：标准字母表，即 Ascii85
  • Z85 (ZeroMQ)：Base85 的字符串安全变体，避免使用引号和反斜杠字符
  • IPv6：适合编码 IPv6 地址的 Base85 变体（RFC 1924）
包含定界符
在数据开头和结尾添加 '<~' 和 '~>' 定界符，这是 Adobe 实现 Base85 的标准做法。

To Bech32.src_description:
Bech32 is an encoding scheme primarily used for Bitcoin SegWit addresses (BIP-0173). It uses a 32-character alphabet that excludes easily confused characters (1, b, i, o) and includes a checksum for error detection.

Bech32m (BIP-0350) is an updated version that fixes a weakness in the original Bech32 checksum and is used for Bitcoin Taproot addresses.

The Human-Readable Part (HRP) identifies the network or purpose (e.g., 'bc' for Bitcoin mainnet, 'tb' for testnet, 'age' for AGE encryption keys).

Maximum output length is 90 characters as per specification.
To Bech32.description:

Bech32m（BIP-0350）是改进版本，修复了原始 Bech32 校验和的一个缺陷，用于比特币 Taproot 地址。

人类可读部分（HRP）标识网络或用途（例如 'bc' 表示比特币主网，'tb' 表示测试网，'age' 表示 AGE 加密密钥）。

按照规范，输出最长为 90 个字符。

Converts the input string to octal bytes separated by the specified delimiter.

e.g. The UTF-8 encoded string Γειά σου becomes 316 223 316 265 316 271 316 254 40 317 203 316 277 317 205
To Octal.description:
将输入字符串转换为以指定分隔符分隔的八进制字节。

例如 UTF-8 编码的字符串 Γειά σου 变为 316 223 316 265 316 271 316 254 40 317 203 316 277 317 205

To Punycode.src_description:
Punycode is a way to represent Unicode with the limited character subset of ASCII supported by the Domain Name System.

e.g. münchen encodes to mnchen-3ya
To Punycode.description:
Punycode 是一种用域名系统（DNS）所支持的有限 ASCII 字符子集来表示 Unicode 的方法。

例如 münchen 编码为 mnchen-3ya

To Quoted Printable.src_description:
Quoted-Printable, or QP encoding, is an encoding using printable ASCII characters (alphanumeric and the equals sign '=') to transmit 8-bit data over a 7-bit data path or, generally, over a medium which is not 8-bit clean. It is defined as a MIME content transfer encoding for use in email.

QP works by using the equals sign '=' as an escape character. It also limits line length to 76, as some software has limits on line length.
To Quoted Printable.description:
Quoted-Printable（QP 编码）是一种使用可打印 ASCII 字符（字母、数字和等号“=”）的编码，用于通过 7 位数据通道或一般意义上不支持 8 位数据的媒介传输 8 位数据。它被定义为电子邮件中使用的 MIME 内容传输编码。

QP 使用等号“=”作为转义字符。由于部分软件限制行长，它还会把行长限制在 76 个字符以内。

Unescape Unicode Characters.src_description:
Converts unicode-escaped character notation back into raw characters.

Supports the prefixes:
  • \u
  • %u
  • U+
e.g. \u03c3\u03bf\u03c5 becomes σου
Unescape Unicode Characters.description:
将 Unicode 转义表示还原为原始字符。

支持以下前缀：
  • \u
  • %u
  • U+
例如 \u03c3\u03bf\u03c5 变为 σου

URL Decode.src_description:
Converts URI/URL percent-encoded characters back to their raw values.

e.g. %3d becomes =
URL Decode.description:
将 URI/URL 百分号编码的字符还原为原始值。

例如 %3d 变为 =

URL Encode.src_description:
Encodes problematic characters into percent-encoding, a format supported by URIs/URLs.

e.g. = becomes %3d
URL Encode.description:
将有问题的字符编码为百分号编码，这是 URI/URL 支持的格式。

例如 = 变为 %3d
